description: crafted-rolled: KL406 on recipes (added, and a rule on a game recipe) that make an opt-in item or a game loot weapon; none on fixed items or on a rolled item without a recipe.

diagnostics.message: recipe "Fx_Rolled_R" makes "Fx_Rolled", which rolls ("rolledLoot": true): a craft comes out as the lowest allowed rarity or a random level while the recipe tooltip shows its rarity and lowest level; remove that for a fixed item

recipe "Fx_Gen_R" makes "Fx_Gen", which rolls ("generateRarity": true): a craft comes out as the lowest allowed rarity or a random level while the recipe tooltip shows its rarity and lowest level; remove that for a fixed item

recipe "Fx_Range_R" makes "Fx_Range", which rolls (a level range): a craft comes out as the lowest allowed rarity or a random level while the recipe tooltip shows its rarity and lowest level; remove that for a fixed item

recipe "Fx_Game_R" makes the game's loot item "Weapon_Fixture_Loot", which keeps generateRarity: a craft comes out as the lowest allowed rarity at a random level; add a new item based on it (fixed by default), or a rule with "generateRarity": false and one level

recipe "Weapon_Fixture_Sword" makes "Fx_Rolled", which rolls ("rolledLoot": true): a craft comes out as the lowest allowed rarity or a random level while the recipe tooltip shows its rarity and lowest level; remove that for a fixed item
